visualReview.method: Actual view_image inspection of all six required desktop/native-fullscreen card screenshots
visualReview.findings: All 8 original titles and Oracle/MySQL credits complete and readable; no quotations, dates, locators or hints rendered; no native-caption or controls overlap with bibliography text. Four longer transaction titles fit on both views.

limitations: Chromium viewport emulation, not physical mobile/iOS Safari.
Only the three changed appendices play at 1x on desktop; no duplicate mobile plays or prior-batch media GETs.
Playback is muted; no human audio/ASR claim. Complete body preservation uses the baseline-SHA-bound full media receipts.
390px embedded video remains small; full reading is inspected in actual native fullscreen at 844×390 and article text.
Citation clicks prevent navigation; source verification is a separate record.
scope: Three batch-5 first appendices; title/credit-only cards, 3 desktop 1x endings and 3 native mobile fullscreen cases. No prior-batch media or old appendix proof.
commitScope: Recorded commit plus the actual tested working-tree VTT boundary correction; final release identity is recorded separately after merge.
